verdict.rationale: OpenRouter ships an official MCP server that lets a connected AI assistant pull live account data (models, prices, credits, rankings) and send test messages via natural-language interaction, plus a chat room for conversational use, but this covers only a slice of the product (mostly read-only data/testing) rather than full natural-language control of account settings, routing rules, budgets, or key management. Missing for 10: evidence that core account/config operations (BYOK setup, workspace budgets, provider restrictions, key rotation) can be driven via natural language, and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's NL command flow.
